description: Service layer for handling business logic related to Notes in a backend API. Provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing a repository for data persistence.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class managing business logic for Note entities, including create, read, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note; assumes title validation is handled elsewhere.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes from the repository.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID; throws exception if note does not exist.
